import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

    dd['q']=pd.qcut(dd[e],5,labels=False)

import statsmodels.api as sm
X=pd.get_dummies(d[['steps_k','hospital']],columns=['hospital'],drop_first=True).astype(float)

# bootstrap

    s=d.sample(len(d),replace=True)
    m=smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)',data=s).fit()
    bs.append(m.params['steps_k'])
bs=np.array(bs)
print("boot mean",bs.mean(),"ci",np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]),"p>0",(bs>0).mean())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']

print()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# meta-analysis of steps_k across sites
res=[]
for h,g in df.groupby('hospital'):
    gg=g.dropna(subset=['steps_k','recovery_score'])
    m=smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k',data=gg).fit()
    res.append((m.params['steps_k'],m.bse['steps_k']))
res=np.array(res)
w=1/res[:,1]**2
pooled=(res[:,0]*w).sum()/w.sum()
se=np.sqrt(1/w.sum())
print("steps_k pooled within:",pooled,"se",se,"z",pooled/se)
# same for all exposures
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
for e in exposures:
    res=[]
    for h,g in df.groupby('hospital'):
        gg=g.dropna(subset=[e,'recovery_score'])
        m=smf.ols(f'recovery_score ~ {e}',data=gg).fit()
        res.append((m.params[e],m.bse[e]))
    res=np.array(res); w=1/res[:,1]**2
    pooled=(res[:,0]*w).sum()/w.sum(); se=np.sqrt(1/w.sum())
    print(f"{e:14s} pooled={pooled: .3f} se={se:.3f} z={pooled/se: .2f}")

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# meta-analysis of steps_k across sites
res=[]
for h,g in df.groupby('hospital'):
    gg=g.dropna(subset=['steps_k','recovery_score'])
    m=smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k',data=gg).fit()
    res.append((m.params['steps_k'],m.bse['steps_k']))
res=np.array(res)
w=1/res[:,1]**2
pooled=(res[:,0]*w).sum()/w.sum()
se=np.sqrt(1/w.sum())
print("steps_k pooled within:",pooled,"se",se,"z",pooled/se)
# same for all exposures
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
for e in exposures:
    res=[]
    for h,g in df.groupby('hospital'):
        gg=g.dropna(subset=[e,'recovery_score'])
        m=smf.ols(f'recovery_score ~ {e}',data=gg).fit()
        res.append((m.params[e],m.bse[e]))
    res=np.array(res); w=1/res[:,1]**2
    pooled=(res[:,0]*w).sum()/w.sum(); se=np.sqrt(1/w.sum())
    print(f"{e:14s} pooled={pooled: .3f} se={se:.3f} z={pooled/se: .2f}")
"}
